# AWS ELB

This plugin collects read-only AWS Elastic Load Balancing v2 evidence and evaluates CCF Rego policy bundles against one normalized input document per ELBv2 resource.

It implements the RunnerV2 gRPC plugin protocol from `github.com/compliance-framework/agent`.

Component subject templates registered during `Init`:

- `aws-elbv2-loadbalancer`
- `aws-elbv2-listener`
- `aws-elbv2-target-group`
- `aws-elbv2-target-health`

Account and region are labels and input context. They are not standalone subjects.

This page is for **operators** who run the `plugin-aws-elb` plugin with the CCF Agent, and for **developers** who write policies for it. It documents [v0.1.3](https://github.com/compliance-framework/plugin-aws-elb/releases/tag/v0.1.3) and is generated from the plugin's [README at v0.1.3](https://github.com/compliance-framework/plugin-aws-elb/blob/v0.1.3/README.md).

## Configuration

The CCF agent passes configuration as flat string fields. Structured values are JSON-encoded strings.

| Key | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `accounts` | `[]` | JSON array of `{account_id, regions[], role_arn, external_id, session_name, tags{}}`. Empty means use the configured AWS credential chain. |
| `default_regions` | `[]` | JSON array used when an account omits `regions`; falls back to the AWS SDK default region. |
| `lookback_days` | `90` | Positive integer no greater than `90`, used for CloudTrail LookupEvents. |
| `policy_inputs` | `{}` | JSON object exposed to Rego as `input.policy_inputs`. |
| `policy_input` | `{}` | Alias for `policy_inputs`. |
| `policy_labels` | `{}` | JSON string map merged into generated evidence labels. |
| `max_concurrency` | `4` | Positive integer no greater than `32`, used as the worker count for account/region collection. |
| `api_timeout_seconds` | `60` | Positive integer timeout per account/region target. |
| `tag_batch_size` | `20` | Positive integer no greater than `20`, used as the ELBv2 `DescribeTags` resource ARN batch size. |

Example:

```json
{
  "accounts": "[{\"account_id\":\"123456789012\",\"regions\":[\"us-east-1\"],\"role_arn\":\"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/elbv2-readonly\",\"external_id\":\"ccf\",\"session_name\":\"ccf-elbv2\",\"tags\":{\"environment\":\"prod\"}}]",
  "default_regions": "[\"us-east-1\"]",
  "lookback_days": "90",
  "policy_inputs": "{\"minimum_availability_zones\":2}",
  "policy_labels": "{\"team\":\"security\"}"
}
```

## Evidence collected

### Coverage

CONFIG evidence includes:

- `DescribeLoadBalancers`
- `DescribeListeners`
- `DescribeTargetGroups`
- `DescribeTargetHealth`
- `DescribeTags` for load balancer, listener, and target group tags

DYNAMIC evidence includes CloudTrail `LookupEvents` for `elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com`, filtered to `CreateListener`, `ModifyListener`, `DeleteListener`, `CreateRule`, `ModifyRule`, and `DeleteRule`, and attached to matching load balancer records as `dynamic.cloudtrail_events`.

Out of scope:

- ACM certificate expiry and renewal status. This plugin does not call `acm.DescribeCertificate`; it only records the listener `certificate_arn`.
- SSL policy cipher inspection. This plugin records only the listener `ssl_policy` string.
- AWS Artifact SOC reports and privacy endpoint inventory.

## Policy input

The plugin evaluates four kinds of resource, and a policy receives one document of the matching kind as `input`. Every document has the same envelope, and `resource.type` says which kind it is: `loadbalancer`, `listener`, `target-group` or `target-health`. Only `config` differs by kind, and a load balancer also carries CloudTrail events under `dynamic`. A bundle is matched to a kind by its name: `plugin-aws-elb-loadbalancer-policies`, `plugin-aws-elb-listener-policies`, `plugin-aws-elb-targetgroup-policies` or `plugin-aws-elb-targethealth-policies`. A bundle with any other name is evaluated against load balancers. The tables list the fields of every kind with nested fields in dot notation, and the example shows one document of each kind under the key named after its `resource.type`; a real input is only the document itself, without that key.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | string | All kinds. Always `v1`. |
| `source` | string | All kinds. Always `aws-elbv2`. |
| `account.account_id` | string | All kinds. AWS account ID. |
| `account.role_arn` | string | All kinds. ARN of the role the plugin assumed for the account. Omitted when none is configured. |
| `account.tags` | object (string to string) | All kinds. Tags configured on the account in the plugin configuration. Omitted when there are none. |
| `region.name` | string | All kinds. AWS region. |
| `resource.id` | string | All kinds. Resource ID, the part of the ARN after `loadbalancer/` or `targetgroup/`. A listener keeps its full `listener/...` part. A target health record is `<target group ID>/<target ID>`. |
| `resource.arn` | string | All kinds. ARN of the resource. A target health record carries the ARN of its target group. |
| `resource.type` | string | All kinds. `loadbalancer`, `listener`, `target-group` or `target-health`. |
| `config.load_balancer_arn` | string | Load balancer, listener and target group. ARN of the load balancer. For a target group it is the first load balancer attached, or empty. |
| `config.dns_name` | string | Load balancer. DNS name of the load balancer. |
| `config.scheme` | string | Load balancer. `internet-facing` or `internal`. |
| `config.type` | string | Load balancer. `application`, `network` or `gateway`. |
| `config.state` | string | Load balancer. State code, such as `active`. |
| `config.availability_zones` | array of strings | Load balancer. Names of the availability zones. |
| `config.listener_arn` | string | Listener. ARN of the listener. |
| `config.protocol` | string | Listener and target group. Protocol, such as `HTTPS` or `HTTP`. |
| `config.port` | integer | Listener and target group. Port. |
| `config.ssl_policy` | string | Listener. Name of the TLS security policy. Empty when the listener has none. |
| `config.certificate_arn` | string | Listener. ARN of the first certificate. Empty when there is none. |
| `config.target_group_arn` | string | Target group and target health. ARN of the target group. |
| `config.health_check_protocol` | string | Target group. Protocol of the health check. |
| `config.health_check_path` | string | Target group. Path of the health check. Empty when it does not apply. |
| `config.healthy_threshold_count` | integer | Target group. Consecutive successes before a target is healthy. |
| `config.unhealthy_threshold_count` | integer | Target group. Consecutive failures before a target is unhealthy. |
| `config.target_id` | string | Target health. ID of the target, such as an instance ID. |
| `config.target_health_state` | string | Target health. Health state, such as `healthy` or `unhealthy`. |
| `dynamic.cloudtrail_events` | array of objects | Load balancer. CloudTrail events for the load balancer within the lookback window, each with `event_name`, `event_time` and `user_identity_arn` (strings). `dynamic` is an empty object on the other kinds. |
| `tags` | object (string to string) | All kinds. ELBv2 tags of the resource. Empty for target health. |
| `collection.collected_at` | string (RFC 3339 time) | All kinds. When the data was collected. |
| `collection.collector_version` | string | All kinds. Always `aws-elbv2`. |
| `collection.collection_type` | string | All kinds. `config_dynamic` for a load balancer, `config` for the others. |
| `collection.lookback_window` | object | Load balancer. `start` and `end` (RFC 3339 times) of the CloudTrail lookback. Omitted on the other kinds. |
| `collection.raw_payload_hashes` | object (string to string) | All kinds. `primary` is a SHA-256 hash of the raw AWS payload, as `sha256:...`. |
| `collection.errors` | array of objects | All kinds. Collection problems for the resource, each with `scope` and `message` (strings). Empty when collection was clean. |
| `policy_inputs` | object | All kinds. The `policy_inputs` object from the plugin configuration, passed through as is. Empty when none is set. |

An example input:

```json
{
  "loadbalancer": {
    "schema_version": "v1",
    "source": "aws-elbv2",
    "account": {
```

## Subject templates

The subject templates this plugin registers. Each example is built from sample data.

### aws-elbv2-loadbalancer

A load balancer. Title: `ELBv2 load balancer {{ .resource_id }} in {{ .account_id }}/{{ .region }}`. The evidence also carries `resource_arn` and `resource_type` labels that are not part of the identity.

| Identity key | Description |
|---|---|
| `account_id` | AWS account ID. |
| `region` | AWS region. |
| `resource_id` | Load balancer ID. |

Example:

```json
{
  "name": "aws-elbv2-loadbalancer",
  "type": "component",
  "title": "ELBv2 load balancer app/payments-alb/50dc6c495c0c9188 in 111122223333/eu-west-1",
  "description": "Elastic Load Balancing v2 load balancer app/payments-alb/50dc6c495c0c9188.",
  "purpose": "Represents an ELBv2 load balancer evaluated for compliance posture.",
  "identityLabels": {
    "account_id": "111122223333",
    "region": "eu-west-1",
    "resource_id": "app/payments-alb/50dc6c495c0c9188"
  }
}
```

### aws-elbv2-listener

A listener on a load balancer. Title: `ELBv2 listener {{ .resource_id }} in {{ .account_id }}/{{ .region }}`. The evidence also carries `resource_arn` and `resource_type` labels that are not part of the identity.

| Identity key | Description |
|---|---|
| `account_id` | AWS account ID. |
| `region` | AWS region. |
| `resource_id` | Listener resource ID. |

Example:

```json
{

  "type": "component",
  "title": "ELBv2 listener listener/app/payments-alb/50dc6c495c0c9188/f2f7dc8efc522ab2 in 111122223333/eu-west-1",
  "description": "Elastic Load Balancing v2 listener listener/app/payments-alb/50dc6c495c0c9188/f2f7dc8efc522ab2.",
  "purpose": "Represents an ELBv2 listener evaluated for TLS endpoint posture.",
  "identityLabels": {
    "account_id": "111122223333",
    "region": "eu-west-1",
    "resource_id": "listener/app/payments-alb/50dc6c495c0c9188/f2f7dc8efc522ab2"
  }
}
```

| Identity key | Description |
|---|---|
| `account_id` | AWS account ID. |
| `region` | AWS region. |
| `resource_id` | Target health ID. |

Example:

```json

  "name": "aws-elbv2-target-health",

    "resource_id": "payments-tg/73e2d6bc24d8a067/i-0abc123def4567890"

}
```

### Rego Input Schema

All records share this envelope:

- `schema_version`: `v1`
- `source`: `aws-elbv2`
- `account`: `{account_id, role_arn, tags}`
- `region`: `{name}`
- `resource`: `{id, arn, type}`
- `config`: resource-specific fields listed below
- `dynamic`: dynamic evidence enrichment; empty for non-loadbalancer records
- `tags`: ELBv2 tags for load balancer, listener, and target-group records; empty for target-health records
- `collection`: collection metadata, raw payload hash, errors, and optional lookback window
- `policy_inputs`: parsed policy input object

#### `loadbalancer`

```json
{
  "schema_version": "v1",
  "source": "aws-elbv2",
  "account": {"account_id": "123456789012", "role_arn": "", "tags": {"environment": "prod"}},
  "region": {"name": "us-east-1"},
  "resource": {
    "id": "app/my-alb/abc123",
    "arn": "arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:123456789012:loadbalancer/app/my-alb/abc123",
    "type": "loadbalancer"
  },
  "config": {
    "load_balancer_arn": "arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:123456789012:loadbalancer/app/my-alb/abc123",
    "dns_name": "my-alb-123.us-east-1.elb.amazonaws.com",
    "scheme": "internet-facing",
    "type": "application",
    "state": "active",
    "availability_zones": ["us-east-1a", "us-east-1b"]
  },
  "dynamic": {
    "cloudtrail_events": [
      {"event_name": "ModifyListener", "event_time": "2026-04-01T10:00:00Z", "user_identity_arn": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/admin"}
    ]
  },
  "tags": {"owner": "platform-team"},
  "collection": {
    "collected_at": "2026-05-14T12:00:00Z",
    "collector_version": "aws-elbv2",
    "collection_type": "config_dynamic",
    "lookback_window": {"start": "2026-02-13T12:00:00Z", "end": "2026-05-14T12:00:00Z"},
    "raw_payload_hashes": {"primary": "sha256:..."},
    "errors": []
  },
  "policy_inputs": {"minimum_availability_zones": 2}
}
```

```json
    "type": "listener"
  },
  "config": {
    "listener_arn": "arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:123456789012:listener/app/my-alb/abc123/def456",
    "load_balancer_arn": "arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:123456789012:loadbalancer/app/my-alb/abc123",
    "protocol": "HTTPS",
```
